case_title: ANYA PEDRO O'NEILL VS. GOODWILL OF THE SAN FRANCISCO BAY

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $10,000.00 FILED BY O'NEILL, ANYA PEDRO AS TO DEFENDANT GOODWILL OF THE SAN FRANCISCO BAY DBA GOODWILL INDUSTRIES OF SAN FRANCISCO, SAN MATEO ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR AUG-07-2023 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506

PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVICE FEE $75. SERVED JUN-21-2023, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT GOODWILL OF THE SAN FRANCISCO BAY DBA GOODWILL INDUSTRIES OF SAN FRANCISCO, SAN MATEO

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF AUG-07-2023 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF AUG-07-2023 BY MARY E. WISS. PLAINTIFF ANYA PEDRO O'NEILL IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT GOODWILL OF THE SAN FRANCISCO BAY IS PRESENT REPRESENTED BY KEVIN JOO, VP OF HUMAN SERVICES. DEFENDANT WITNESS MICHAEL MILES PLAYED SURVAILLANCE FOOTAGE OF THE INCIDENT VIEWED BY ALL PARTIES. HONORABLE MARY E WISS FINDS THAT PLAINTIFF'S REQUESTED CONTINUANCE FOR ADDITIONAL EVIDENCE IS NOT NECESSARY. PLAINTIFF EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: MARY E. WISS; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-07-2023 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF O'NEILL, ANYA PEDRO IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT GOODWILL OF THE SAN FRANCISCO BAY DBA GOODWILL INDUSTRIES OF SAN FRANCISCO, SAN MATEO WITH HER LEFT-HAND PLAINTIFF TAKES AN ORNAMENTAL FISH WITH METAL SCALES OFF SHOULDER HEIGHT SHELF AT GOODWILL STORE. SHE TRIES TO RETURN IT TO THE SHELF BUT IT FALLS OFF AND STRIKES HER RIGHT HAND. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
